temporal.source_faithful_note: The official page was published 5 May 2018 and says the arrest/intervention occurred the previous evening. Contemporary reporting describes repeated maltreatment, but no defensible start date is available.

event_identity.occurrence_summary: A domestic-violence intervention in Lamezia Terme led police to place a family member in safety and arrest a person in flagrante for repeated family maltreatment.
event_identity.identity_rationale: The source and contemporaneous reporting support repeated maltreatment rather than reducing the case to the single intervention evening. The course-of-conduct start remains unknown.
